subject: Follow-up on MetaDefender Core not starting after the upgrade
body:
Hello Marcus,

Thank you for your time today. Here is a short recap.

What we found: after the upgrade to 5.13.2, the Core service stops because its web service port, 8008, is already in use. The process holding it looks like an old Core process from before the upgrade.

Next steps:
1. You: end that old process (ID 4312), start the Core service and tell me whether it stays running.
2. You: send the installer log from last night.
3. Me: send the steps for stopping the services cleanly, and check with our engineering team why the old process was still running.

More background on stopping and starting the services: https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/core/administration/start-stop-services

claims_needing_verification.claim: The old Core process was left running by the upgrade installer.
claims_needing_verification.reason: Not yet confirmed with engineering or in the installer log.
